listing.name: Descent 3 / Piccu Engine (InsanityBringer)
listing.summary: Explore Descent 3 / Piccu Engine (InsanityBringer) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Add your own Descent 3 data before Play
steps.instruction: Before Play, open the new runtime folder and copy only the original data from your own patched Descent 3 1.4 installation: d3.hog, extra.hog, extra13.hog, and missions/d3.mn3, d3_2.mn3, d3voice1.hog, d3voice2.hog and training.mn3. Keep the old installation intact. Add merc.hog and missions/merc.mn3 only if you own Mercenary; the upstream also recognizes the Steam extra1.hog expansion layout. For multiplayer, follow the packaged README for your own netgames directory and missions/Fury.mn3 and bedlam.mn3; movies are optional. Do not copy old top-level executables or DLLs over this runtime. Then choose Play. This ZIP has no installer; Portcove does not verify a retail-edition checksum for this upstream setup route.

steps.title: Keep a separate backup of your Saved Games profile
steps.instruction: Normal saves, pilots, demos, screenshots and temporary scripts use Windows Saved Games/Piccu Engine. The SDL configuration is Saved Games/Piccu Engine/PiccuEngine.registry, including when portable mode is used. Back up that external profile separately before changing runtime versions; older versions may not read newer data. Keep your original HOG files, missions, netgames and movies available separately too.

steps.title: Keep customized copies separate
steps.instruction: Adding piccu_portable, custom -setdir/-tempdir arguments or failure to resolve Saved Games can place player data and generated DLL caches in the runtime folder. An early startup crash can also leave a dump beside the player. Close the game and preserve your actual player-data locations before changing a customized copy. Do not copy generated script caches into another engine version; follow upstream instructions when changing storage modes.

steps.title: Choose this Preview deliberately
steps.instruction: This optional Windows Preview is the upstream SDL prototype, with fixes for pilot-control loading and input issues. Some settings do not import from older Piccu versions, and switching fullscreen/windowed can show a stray cursor. The stable v1.2.2 upstream copy remains available through the release list or an existing installation; it has separate known control issues. The player is Win32 and can run on 64-bit Windows through Windows compatibility support. Other platforms, gameplay, minimum Windows versions and populated-save restoration are not qualified here.
